verdict.rationale: Vendor docs state that Kintsugi registers you, 'files and remits on schedule,' and 'files everywhere you sell.' Filings APIs exist to list filings by jurisdiction, status, and registration, and credit notes flow into filings. The story's explicit vendor guarantee covering late-filing penalties is not evidenced anywhere, and all support is vendor-claimed. Missing for 10: a penalty or late-filing guarantee, documentation of how returns are prepared and remittance is funded, and independent or hands-on corroboration of on-time filing across all jurisdictions.
